svg.title: In Türkiye, the two largest groups of online shoppers bought one to five times in the last three months
svg.desc: Waterfall chart: In Türkiye, the two largest groups of online shoppers bought one to five times in the last three months: Frequency: Once or twice: 13.9%, Three to five times: 14.1%, Six to ten times: 5.7%, More than ten times: 8.6%; Total: Online shoppers: 42.3%.
